headline: Gartner (IT) Lifted Guidance And Buybacks, Is The Rebound Already Priced In?
summary: Why Gartner Stock Is Back in Focus After Q2 2026 Results Gartner (IT) is back on investors' radar after reporting its second quarter 2026 results and stepping up capital returns through sizeable share repurchases and a higher buyback authorization. The company reported Q2 revenue of US$1.68b with net income of US$275.5m. Earnings per share from continuing operations reached US$4.14 on both a basic and diluted basis, compared with the prior year period. For the first six months of 2026,...
